segments.contextAfter: `reply`: A block or closure to indicate success or failure. If reading succeeds, pass the link’s contents as an [`FSFileName`](fsfilename.md) and a `nil` error. If reading fails, pass the relevant error as the second parameter; FSKit ignores any [`FSFileName`](fsfilename.md) in this case. For an `async` Swift implementation, there’s no reply handler; simply return the [`FSFileName`](fsfilename.md) or throw an error.
